name: Cosplay Helmet Kit with Prop Night-Vision, Headset and Skull Mask
description:
A plastic costume helmet with side rails and Velcro panels, a flip-up mount, a decorative night-vision model, a Bluetooth headset with mic (Type-C charging) and a skull-face mask with balaclava. Kits vary in what they include. The night-vision unit is a prop and does not provide night vision.

Costume use only. The helmet is not protective: not for riding, cycling or impact, and not bulletproof.

supplier.name: Caoxian Xiran Brother and Sister Clothing Factory

source.notes: Range CNY 68-158 by kit; per-kit prices not in screenshots, 68 is the lowest. Colours black and tan on listing; recommend black only (military-look gear risk in Nigeria). Return rate not visible; repurchase 55.56%. Headset has a battery: ships_by_air false. All 13 supplier photos carry a large Chinese watermark across the centre plus Chinese labels and a patch on the helmet: no clean store photo possible by cropping. Skull mask resembles a well-known game character: no game/brand names used. Kit contents, weight, head size unknown.
